name: Cyberpunk 2077
notes: Cyberpunk supports the DualSense itself (patch 2.1+), so DS5 Forge stays hands-off and lets the game drive the triggers. Wired (USB): the game also does its own HD haptics, DS5 Forge does nothing. Wireless: DS5 Forge adds HD haptics from the game's sound. For triggers over Bluetooth, or extra trigger effects, install the 'DualSense Adaptive Trigger Effects' CET mod (Nexus) - DS5 Forge finds its trigger file automatically. Turn Steam Input OFF for Cyberpunk.
